scientific_question: Can a single availability-aware FIBRE computation graph absorb the heterogeneous evidence channels previously separated across BiME-Rank routing and FIBRE side experiments, while training directly on the general sparse reaction-protein relation set?

architecture.base: one 128-dimensional universal component plus eight 32-dimensional query-conditioned local modes
architecture.missing_policy: unavailable specialists receive exact zero mixture mass and the available channels renormalise
architecture.formal_strict_temporal_seed_context: disabled because the formal evaluation is zero-shot

formal_external_evaluation.protocol: Rhea release 128 -> 141 strict double-cold, same frozen common supports used by BiME-Rank
formal_external_evaluation.selection_role: veto/record only; no hyperparameter or architecture retuning is allowed after the formal result is revealed

engineering_smoke_boundary: Before this lock, a 2,048-pair one-epoch run was used only to verify loading, backpropagation and end-to-end strict-evaluation plumbing. Its strict metrics were not used to choose the formal architecture or hyperparameters.
